column1: The insurance policy is a strong example of that care. Many of the challenges we face are beyond our control
column2: and having insurance gives us a sense of protection in those situations. The cost is fair and reasonable
column3: especially when you consider the potential benefits during difficult times. It provides reassurance that we won’t be left completely vulnerable when unexpected issues arise.

column2: from my experience as a farmer
column3: certain seasons can be particularly difficult. There are times when yields are low or conditions are unfavorable
column4: and during those periods
column5: we are especially at risk. I would encourage VisionFund to consider expanding their support beyond health insurance to include coverage or assistance tailored to these seasonal challenges.
